entries.text: A heavy and rather magnificent brass key that fits no lock.
A sharpened, polished half-orc's tooth on a silver chain.
A rolled-up and quite extraordinary map, drawn in squid ink.
A music box that plays a lullaby backwards.
A letter of introduction to someone who does not exist.
A copper coin stamped on both sides with the same face.
A tiny wicker cage holding a sleeping cricket.
A deck of cards that is missing all the queens.
